name: How much extra does a detached ADU add to monthly utility bills?

mainEntity.name: How much should a homeowner expect monthly electric, water, and sewer costs to rise after adding a detached ADU?
mainEntity.text: How much should a homeowner expect monthly electric, water, and sewer costs to rise after adding a detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Utility operating costs are often overlooked during ADU planning. A detached ADU will usually increase monthly water, electricity, and sometimes gas use, especially if it is fully occupied by a tenant or family member. The exact increase depends on the unit size, the efficiency of the HVAC system, how many appliances are installed, and whether the occupant uses the space full-time. Shared-meter properties can also make it harder to track the actual cost increase. Homeowners should think beyond construction price and ask about ongoing operating costs, maintenance, and whether separate billing is desired. Energy-efficient systems, high-performance insulation, and water-saving fixtures can help control monthly expenses, but they may raise upfront cost slightly. This is one of the most useful questions for anyone comparing detached ADU designs because the lowest build price is not always the lowest lifetime cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Monthly utility costs usually rise after a detached ADU is occupied, but the increase depends on the unit size, occupancy, appliance choices, climate control system, and whether utilities are shared or separately metered.
